title: ICAI CA Foundation & Intermediate September 2026 Exam Admit Cards Released!
content:
# ICAI CA Foundation & Intermediate September 2026 Exam Admit Cards Released!

Ek important update hai for all CA Foundation aur Intermediate students! The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ne September 2026 examinations ke admit cards release kar diye hain.

Yahan essential details hain:

*   **Admit Card Release Date:** Download links became active on August 14, 2026.
*   **Access Completion:** Admit cards for all candidates, including regional courses, are scheduled to be fully accessible by August 17, 2026.
*   **How to Download:** Students can access their hall tickets through the official ICAI e-Services Portal using their Self Service Portal (SSP) ID.
*   **CA Foundation Exam Dates:** The examinations are scheduled for September 2, 5, 7, and 9, 2026.
*   **CA Intermediate Exam Timings:** All CA Intermediate papers for the September 2026 session will be held from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM IST.

## Read the Official Document
*   [Download the Official Admit Card here](https://eservices.icai.org/)

*Published on: 17 August 2026*
